docs/requirements/decisions/authority-session-receipt-gate-execution.md:134 and :261 WHY: the document says the receipt-ref artifact must let a consumer answer which gate consumed the receipt, but the example uses gateConsumers=["REVIEW","TEST","DONE"] as a static field on the ref itself. That collapses eligibility and actual consumption into one value and creates an overclaim risk where a ref can appear to have satisfied DONE before any DONE decision consumed it. Fix: split static eligibility from recorded consumption events, or remove gateConsumers from the example until a per-gate consumption schema is defined.
